Policy 3: first select ace of clubs, ace of spades; then select the first object in the order of the two remaining objects.
Policy 4: first select ace of clubs, ace of spades; then select the last object in the order of the two remaining objects.

Return only JSON with "policy_1", "policy_2", "policy_3", and "policy_4"; each contains "first_feedback", "second_feedback", and "final".
